blog/devfest-sudbury-2026.title: DevFest Sudbury 2026: N.O.D.E. partners with GDG Sudbury
blog/devfest-sudbury-2026.brief: Free and open to all on Saturday, November 28, 2026 at College Boreal. N.O.D.E. is proud to partner with GDG Sudbury.
blog/devfest-sudbury-2026.content:
Northern Ontario's tech community is growing fast, and **DevFest Sudbury 2026** is proof of that.

NODE is proud to partner with GDG Sudbury to bring this back to Sudbury bigger than ever. If you are a developer, student, founder, or just someone who wants to understand where AI and technology are taking us, this is your day.

**Free. Open to all. Right here in Sudbury.**

## Build, Secure, Scale: Developers and Builders in the Agentic Era

Northern Ontario's biggest developer conference is back, hosted by GDG Sudbury in partnership with N.O.D.E. (Northern Ontario Dev Exchange).

- **When:** Saturday, November 28, 2026
- **Where:** Collège Boréal, Sudbury

## What is happening

- Talks from Google Developer Experts (GDEs)
- Local voices from mining, CEOs, and industry experts
- A hands-on hackathon with prizes
- Start-up booths
- Free lunch and networking

Open to everyone: students, developers, founders, and anyone curious about AI and agents. All levels are welcome.

[RSVP now](https://lnkd.in/ggA7JX9G). Spots are limited, so grab yours early and share this with your friends, classmates, and coworkers.

More announcements are coming soon on speakers, the hackathon, volunteer sign-ups, and open source projects.

blog/grok-bot-meetup-recap.title: That's a wrap on the Grok Bot Meetup: N.O.D.E.'s first official event
blog/grok-bot-meetup-recap.brief: Thank you to everyone who joined us at the Jim Fielding Innovation Space at Laurentian University.
blog/grok-bot-meetup-recap.content:
Thank you to everyone who joined us this evening at the Jim Fielding Innovation Space at Laurentian University. Seeing developers, students, tech professionals, and community partners come together to explore Grok and AI tools was exactly what N.O.D.E. - Northern Ontario Dev Exchange - was created for.

## Highlights from the evening

- Great conversations around Grok, AI agents, and developer tooling
- New connections made across Sudbury's tech community
- Good snacks, better company

A huge thank you to Laurentian University and the Jim Fielding Innovation Space for hosting us, and to everyone who helped make our first event a success.

This is just the beginning. N.O.D.E. will be organizing more meetups, workshops, hackathons, and networking events to grow and connect the tech ecosystem across Northern Ontario, and we would love to have you there.

If you joined us, connect with someone you met and let us know what you would like to see at future events. Follow N.O.D.E. to stay updated on upcoming events, opportunities, and initiatives.

blog/introducing-node.title: Introducing N.O.D.E. - Northern Ontario Dev Exchange
blog/introducing-node.brief: N.O.D.E. is incorporated as a not-for-profit organization focused on strengthening Northern Ontario's technology community.
blog/introducing-node.content:
We are excited to officially introduce N.O.D.E., incorporated as a not-for-profit organization focused on strengthening Northern Ontario's technology community.

NODE brings together developers, students, tech professionals, founders, employers, and community partners to create more opportunities for connection, learning, collaboration, and professional growth across Northern Ontario.

We will be organizing meetups, workshops, hackathons, networking events, and other initiatives that help grow and connect the tech ecosystem in the North.

## Our first event: Grok Bot Meetup | Sudbury

- **Date:** September 15, 2026, 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM
- **Place:** Jim Fielding Innovation Space, Laurentian University, Sudbury
- Free snacks provided

Join us for an evening of networking, exploring Grok and AI tools, and connecting with developers and tech enthusiasts in the community.

Follow N.O.D.E. to stay updated on upcoming events, opportunities, and initiatives across Northern Ontario. We are looking forward to building this community together.
